# track-trace

> A comprehensive multi-carrier shipment tracking platform supporting parcels, air cargo, postal services, and ocean freight from hundreds of logistics providers worldwide.

track-trace enables users to track shipments across major carriers including UPS, DHL, FedEx, TNT, and 186+ postal services globally. The platform offers customizable dashboards, air cargo tracking for 244 airlines, and specialized freight tracking solutions through its product suite.

## Key Topics

- Multi-carrier tracking
- Parcel tracking
- Air cargo tracking
- Ocean freight/Bill of lading
- International shipping
- Postal/EMS services
- Personal dashboard
- Shipping carriers
- Logistics directory
- Courier services
- Package tracking
- Freight tracking
- track-trace+
- track-traceConnect
- GDPR compliance

## Tracking Services

- [Parcel Tracking](https://www.track-trace.com): Track parcels with UPS, DHL, TNT, FedEx and other carriers
- [Air Cargo Tracking](https://www.track-trace.com/aircargo): Track air cargo for 244 airlines using AWB numbers
- [Postal & EMS Tracking](https://www.track-trace.com/post): Track Post/EMS shipments across 186 countries
- [Ocean Freight Tracking](https://www.track-trace.com/bol): Track ocean freight shipments using bill of lading numbers

## Products & Solutions

- [Products Overview](https://www.track-trace.com/products): Overview of track-trace, track-traceConnect, and track-trace+ products
- [Personal Dashboard](https://www.track-trace.com/my): Customizable personal dashboard for multi-carrier shipment tracking
